caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian-style upholstered armchair with a carved wooden frame. The wood is a medium brown color with ornate detailing along the top, arms, and legs. The upholstery features a rich, multicolored floral pattern with prominent pink, purple, and white flowers and green leafy stems spread across the backrest, seat, and visible parts of the armrests. The chair's arms are cushioned with a textured gray fabric transitioning into the floral pattern toward the seat and back. The background is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects or designs. The artist's name, "Grace Thomas," along with "Santa Fe," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Rocker
